title: Latent Lattice Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. translated_abstract: 语言模型通常通过更深或循环的层以及潜在推理步骤来增加每个token的计算量，同时更丰富的残差连接可以改善跨层的信息流动。我们则选择增加计算容量：即模型所维持的活跃计算状态的数量。我们引入了潜在格，这是一组沿时间循环运行的逐层水平潜在流，与贯穿网络深度的垂直残差流并行运作。与超连接、mHC以及注意力或值残差类似，潜在格增强了残差流，但它并非通过深度添加或重新路由残差路径，而是提供了跨token持续存在的伴随计算状态。与混合Transformer-SSM架构不同——后者的循环状态主要用作序列混合的内部记忆——这些潜在状态直接调节垂直流的注意力、KV缓存写入、MLP计算和……
tldr: 该论文提出潜在格架构，通过在每层引入沿时间维度循环运行的水平潜在流来增加模型的活跃计算状态数量，从而在不加深网络的情况下提升模型的计算容量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently over time alongside the vertical residual stream, increasing the number of active computational states to boost a model's computational capacity without deepening the network.
